comparison_warning: The three stacks implement the closest available counterparts, not identical statements. Report each circuit identity and never rank stacks as if the circuits were interchangeable.

stacks.browser_adapter: tooling/provekit-wasm at provekit_v1.core_commit, fixed-16-worker threaded wasm-bindgen package
stacks.browser_sdk_compatibility: @worldcoin/provekit@0.1.0 is retained only as an incompatibility record; it is not a measured runtime

stacks.native_backend_policy: Rapidsnark preferred; Arkworks plus rust-witness is a target-specific fallback

noir.identity: binds challenge, ceremony type, origin, RP-ID hash, UP/UV flags, signature, and public key

circom.identity: closest available ES256 Circom counterpart; it does not bind the complete Noir assertion statement
application circuits reported under distinct circuit names

circom_native_backend_gate.iphone_policy: Use Rapidsnark only after every exact circuit passes build, valid-proof verification, tamper rejection, warmup, and five measured samples.
circom_native_backend_gate.motorola_policy: Capture ABI and userspace bitness with ADB. Try Rapidsnark only when supported; otherwise use Mopro Arkworks plus rust-witness and retain the backend difference in every row.

compatibility_fallback.warning: Known documented feature gaps include RSA-related circuits.

oprf_o2_canonical_override.scope: oprf_nullifier / O2-world-id-nullifier on Mac, iPhone, and Motorola E15
oprf_o2_canonical_override.measurement_boundary: raw frozen input through circom-witness-rs graph execution and TACEO Groth16 proof serialization
oprf_o2_canonical_override.reason: The TACEO helper path is the qualified replacement for the prior Rapidsnark/Rust-witness OPRF rows; all six cold/warm target series are measured with the same frozen zkey, graph, and input bundle.

noir_native_gate.port_policy: Mechanical ports are allowed only when semantic outputs remain identical.
noir_native_gate.motorola_policy: If ADB confirms armv7 userspace and the Mopro Noir adapter cannot target it, record unsupported with the captured device evidence.

publication.measurement_boundary: raw structured circuit input through fresh witness generation to serialized proof bytes
publication.payload_definition: PKP/prover plus the frozen proving input; verifier-only artifacts, APK/IPA/XCUITest packages, and transport duplication are excluded

input_to_proof_campaign.measurement_boundary: raw structured circuit input through fresh witness generation to serialized proof bytes
input_to_proof_campaign.verification_boundary: valid-proof acceptance and tampered-proof rejection are mandatory but outside headline timing

passport_p1.identity: P1-matched monolithic RSA-4096 passport integrity, registry authorization, DG1 validity, and minimum-age assertion

circom_oprf_taceo_replacement.measurement_boundary: raw frozen input through generated Circom witness graph, Groth16 proof generation, and exact proof serialization
circom_oprf_taceo_replacement.qualification: valid-proof acceptance and tampered-proof rejection on every target and timing mode; exact graph, zkey, input, proof, and process-memory hashes are retained

timing_modes.cold_local: fresh process and proof runtime per attempt with locked assets already local
timing_modes.warm_reuse: initialized runtime is reused while witness and proof are regenerated
